features.feature_name: Intel TDX support on C3 machines
features.feature_summary: Confidential Space supports Intel CPUs in the C3 machine family with Intel TDX.
features.extended_definition: Confidential Space supports Intel CPUs in the C3 machine family with Intel TDX.

features.feature_summary: Confidential Space workloads can add specific Linux capabilities, including CAP_SYS_ADMIN.
features.extended_definition: Confidential Space workloads can add specific Linux capabilities, including CAP_SYS_ADMIN.

features.feature_summary: Confidential Space provides a namespaced cgroup with read or write access.
features.extended_definition: Confidential Space provides a namespaced cgroup with read or write access.

features.feature_summary: Confidential Space supports AWS tokens for integration with AWS resources.
features.extended_definition: Confidential Space supports AWS tokens for integration with AWS resources.

features.feature_summary: Confidential Space images provide CPU metric monitoring.
features.extended_definition: Confidential Space images provide CPU metric monitoring.

features.feature_summary: Confidential Space workloads can configure the size of /dev/shm.
features.extended_definition: Confidential Space workloads can configure the size of /dev/shm.

features.feature_summary: Confidential Space can retry container signature fetch operations.
features.extended_definition: Confidential Space can retry container signature fetch operations.

features.feature_summary: Confidential Space supports IPv6 ingress network traffic.
features.extended_definition: Confidential Space supports IPv6 ingress network traffic.

features.feature_summary: Confidential Space workloads support tmpfs mounts.
features.extended_definition: Confidential Space workloads support tmpfs mounts.

features.feature_name: Automatic boot disk stateful partition resizing
features.feature_summary: Confidential Space supports automatic resizing of the boot disk stateful partition.
features.extended_definition: Confidential Space supports automatic resizing of the boot disk stateful partition.

features.feature_summary: Data collaborators can check whether memory monitoring is enabled on a Confidential VM running a Confidential Space workload.
features.extended_definition: Data collaborators can check whether memory monitoring is enabled on a Confidential VM running a Confidential Space workload.

features.feature_summary: A workload operator can enable memory monitoring on the Confidential VM running the workload.
features.extended_definition: A workload operator can enable memory monitoring on the Confidential VM running the workload.

features.feature_summary: Confidential Space supports custom attestation tokens for authenticating workloads to relying parties outside Google Cloud.
features.extended_definition: Confidential Space supports custom attestation tokens for authenticating workloads to relying parties outside Google Cloud.

features.feature_summary: Confidential Space can be used with the Split-Trust Encryption Tool (STET).
features.extended_definition: Confidential Space can be used with the Split-Trust Encryption Tool (STET).

features.feature_summary: Confidential Space can be protected with VPC Service Controls perimeters.
features.extended_definition: Confidential Space can be protected with VPC Service Controls perimeters.

features.feature_summary: Confidential Space supports opening ports for ingress network traffic.
features.extended_definition: Confidential Space supports opening ports for ingress network traffic.

features.feature_name: Confidential Space image support status assertion
features.feature_summary: The assertion.submods.confidential_space.support_attributes attestation claim can verify the support status of the Confidential Space image in use.
features.extended_definition: The assertion.submods.confidential_space.support_attributes attestation claim can verify the support status of the Confidential Space image in use.
